mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, it is 72 degrees and overcast near Reddan Soccer Park, and the moon is a waxing crescent. Expect the temperature to drop to an overnight low of 57 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The Verona Police Department has released a summary of activity from October 5 to October 12, which highlights a series of vehicle crashes and one warrant arrest. Detailed logs indicate a variety of incidents, including traffic complaints and property checks.

Today, you can participate in Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the local fun continues with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and various trivia nights at local venues.
Among the noteworthy calls, a 17-year-old was involved in a motor vehicle crash on October 7 when their electric motorcycle collided with a vehicle on Basswood Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight, so stop in for a scoop.
